{'translation': '警務處國家安全處今日（9日）直接發稿，表示三個月前曾拘捕一名52歲男子，並於前日（10月7日）落案起訴他一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。據《法庭線》報道，被告名字為羅耀輝。', 'source': '警務處國家安全處今日（9日）直接出稿，表示三個月前曾拘捕一名52歲男子，並在前日（10月7日）落案起訴他一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。據《法庭線》報道，被告名字為羅耀輝。'}

{'translation': 'The government issued a press release today stating that the National Security Department arrested a 52-year-old local man in the Eastern District on July 9, on suspicion of violating Article 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, namely the offence of "publishing a publication with seditious intent while knowing it to be so".', 'source': '政府今日出稿指，國安處在7月9日，在東區拘捕一名52歲本地男子，指他涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條，「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。'}

{'translation': 'The police pointed out that the arrested man was suspected of repeatedly publishing messages with seditious intent through online social media platforms, the content of which included inciting hatred towards the country, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government, and the judiciary, as well as inciting others to attempt to alter matters lawfully established by the SAR through unlawful means.', 'source': '警方指，被捕男子涉嫌多次透過網上社交平台，發布具有煽動意圖信息，內容包括引起他人對國家及香港特區政府和司法機構的憎恨，及煽惑他人企圖不循合法途徑，改變特區依法制定的事項。'}

{'translation': 'The 52-year-old man was arrested nearly three months ago, and on October 7, the police formally charged him with one count of "publishing a publication with seditious intent while knowing it to be so". He appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates\' Courts on the same day. According to the Court Wire (《法庭線》), the defendant\'s name is Lo Yiu-fai (羅耀輝), and the case was adjourned to December 15 for further mention.', 'source': '該52歲男子被捕近三個月，警方在10月7日落案控告他一項「明知而發布具煽動意圖的刊物」罪。當日在西九龍裁判法院提堂。據《法庭線》報道，被告名字為羅耀輝，案件押後至12月15日再訊。'}

{'translation': 'Recent law enforcement actions by the national security police involving sedition offences include, on September 30, the arrest of Li Ying-chi (李盈姿) and Tang Ho-wing (鄧浩榮), founder of online media "Explosion Head" (爆炸頭), in connection with alleged incitement outside Prince Edward station on August 31 this year. In the same case, the national security police conducted three rounds of enforcement operations, arresting a total of eight people.', 'source': '近期國安警涉及煽動罪的執法，包括在9月30日，拘捕李盈姿、網媒爆炸頭創辦人鄧浩榮、他們指涉及今年8月31日在太子站外煽動，同一案件，國安警前後三次執法，共拘捕八人。'}

{'translation': 'This Tuesday (6th), the national security police arrested one man and one woman in Kowloon. The two were suspected of violating Article 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, namely the offence of "doing an act with seditious intent". Both are 38 years old. The man is a licensed insurance broker, alleged to have operated a page on a social media platform, where the published posts were accused of inciting hatred towards the constitutional order of the SAR. The arrested man sells insurance products. According to reports, the two arrested persons are former "North District Source" (北區動源) member Wong Ka-ho (黃嘉浩) and his female companion. According to reports, the two had previously established a social media page called "Yellow Insurance" (黃式保險).', 'source': '本周二（6日），國安警在九龍拘捕一男一女，兩人被指涉嫌違反《維護國家安全條例》第24條「出於煽動意圖作出一項具煽動意圖的作為」罪。兩人年齡都是38歲，男子為一名持牌保險經紀，他被指涉嫌於社交平台營運專頁，專頁上發布的帖文，被指煽動他人對特區憲制秩序憎恨。被捕男子有銷售保險產品。據報，兩名被捕人為前「北區動源」成員黃嘉浩，及其女友人。據報兩人曾成立社交媒體專頁「黃式保險（YellowInsurance）」。'}
